question: Does the unchanged positive disk-area compiler remain an adequate direct representation of the 12.5um circular scanner aperture at 4000 dpi, without an oversampled reference dependency or a larger Gaussian approximation?

compiler.cell_rule: unchanged deterministic subpixel-centre disk-area fraction followed by exact sum normalization and zero-border crop
compiler.support: minimal odd square containing all positive cell-area weights

controls: equal-second-moment Gaussian MTF at the same target lattice
forbidden: change the disk-area compiler, aperture diameter, target pitch, subpixel count, controls or gates after scoring
fall back to the 1um reference inside target execution
add support, negative taps, deconvolution or fitted correction
modify the production scanner profile or native runtime
claim modern scanner calibration, photographic quality or product promotion

branch_rule.pass: Retain a direct 4000-dpi circular-aperture research compiler and next measure cost/parity before any optional profile schema proposal.
branch_rule.fail: Close direct target compilation without capacity rescue; retain P6AA reference and the existing Gaussian product approximation.

claim_ceiling: Generic synthetic 4000-dpi circular scanner-aperture compiler evidence; no measured modern device, scanner profile or product integration.
